title: US approves sale of F-16 maintenance equipment to Ukraine

blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — The United States has approved the sale of maintenance equipment and other items to Ukraine for its fleet of F-16 fighter jets, a transaction worth $622 million financed by European partners, the State Department announced Wednesday. The funding comes from Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway, the State Department said in a statement, underlining that “there will be no US funds associated with this transfer.” It said the package includes “Cartridge Actuated Device/Propellant Actuated Devices; lab equipment; and transportation support,” which will be added to a smaller previous sale below the limit required to be reported to Congress.
